info.title: InstantNode PAT API
info.description:
The **Personal Access Token (PAT) API** is the single API surface for your InstantNode account. It operates strictly on the token owner's own resources - read your services, control power, provision and manage vServers, game servers, Discord bots, webspaces, domains and managed email (mail domains, mailboxes, passwords, aliases), run and schedule backups, manage host firewall rules, and read billing history.

**Base URL:** `https://instantnode.eu/api/pat`  •  **Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer inpat_...`  •  JSON in, JSON out; every response carries an `ok` boolean.

**Retired:** the old reseller API (`/api/resell`) now returns `410 Gone` - PATs are the single API surface.

**Poll politely:** at most once per 30 seconds per endpoint; excessive polling may be rate-limited (`429`).

**Panel-only surfaces** return `403 not_available_via_api` by design (account-security / abuse boundaries): the file manager, console/VNC access, live SSE streams, sharing/manager management, server **deletion** (servers always run to the end of the paid billing period - cancel by disabling auto-renew), secret-token rotation, cancelling a Managed Email subscription (it purges every mailbox), and payments/top-ups.

**Compatibility:** breaking changes ship under a new version prefix; additive fields may appear within `v1` at any time - ignore unknown fields.

get.description: A single flat inventory of everything the token owner hosts: vServers/containers, game servers, Discord bots and webspaces, each with its current status. Ideal as the entry point for a dashboard or bot. Status is the last known state; call the per-resource detail endpoint for a live power state.
Your current InstantNode balance in EUR. Check before provisioning - creation is charged from this balance.

post.description: Start, stop or restart one of your vServers (KVM/LXC/VDS/Windows/Storage). `action` is one of `start`, `stop`, `restart`. A suspended server returns 403.
Start, stop or restart one of your game servers. Same actions as containers.
Start, stop or restart one of your Discord bots.

get.description: Valid plan presets and OS templates for provisioning a vServer. VDS plans come with dedicated, pinned CPU cores. Pass the returned `template` value and a preset id when creating.
All vServers on the account with their stored state.

post.description: Create a server through the exact same pipeline, pricing and balance checks as the panel (presets only). The cost is charged to your balance. Returns 402 `insufficient_balance` (with `required`) or 409 `profile_incomplete` if billing details are missing.

get.description: Full detail including the LIVE power state (polled from the hypervisor). `hasRootPassword` tells you whether a root password is stored; the plaintext is never in this payload - reveal it deliberately via `/root-password`.
Live CPU / memory / disk / network usage for the server, read from the hypervisor.
Information reported by the QEMU guest agent (interfaces, addresses) when the agent is running inside the guest.

post.description: Servers cannot be deleted via the API (or the panel) - they always run until the end of the paid billing period. Disabling auto-renew IS the cancellation: the billing cron expires the server once the paid runtime is over. Re-enable any time before expiry to keep it.
Charge your balance and extend the paid runtime by N billing cycles.

get.description: The templates/options available for reinstalling this server, to build a reinstall request.

post.description: DESTRUCTIVE. Wipes the server and reinstalls it from the chosen template. All data is lost.
DESTRUCTIVE. Resets the server to a clean state of its current OS. All data is lost.

get.description: A price quote for upgrading the server's resources, before committing.

post.description: Upgrade the server to a larger preset. Charges the prorated difference from your balance.

get.description: The IPv4 addresses assigned to this server (primary + any additional).

post.description: Purchase and attach an additional IPv4 address (charged from balance).

delete.description: Release a previously purchased additional IPv4 address.

post.description: Acknowledge that a requested reverse-DNS (PTR) change has been applied.
Set a new root/administrator password on the server itself. This is the server credential, not your account password.

put.description: Set a cosmetic display label for the server (does not change the hostname). Empty resets to the hostname.
Store a free-text credentials note for the server (shown to the owner alongside the password).

get.description: Deliberate, owner-only reveal of the stored root password. Intentionally NOT part of any routine payload (so a status poll never carries the secret); each reveal is logged. Returns null when none is stored (e.g. Windows KVM keeps no recoverable password).
The most recent provisioning job for your account, to follow an install right after POST /v1/containers.
Status of a specific provisioning job.
List this server's backups (max 3 kept) plus the current daily schedule.

post.description: Start a manual backup immediately. Rate-limited to one manual run per server per 30 minutes (429 `backup_cooldown`).
Configure the daily backup schedule, or disable it.
DESTRUCTIVE. Restore the server from a backup volume - the current disk is replaced. The server stays stopped afterwards; start it separately.

get.description: The customer firewall rules for this server, plus `enabled` (false while the whole firewall is switched off).

post.description: Add a rule (max 50 per server). `dport` requires a `proto`. New rules are inserted at the top. Returns 409 `firewall_paused` while the firewall is switched off.

delete.description: Delete the rule at position `pos` (from the list endpoint). Returns 409 `firewall_paused` while the firewall is switched off.

put.summary: Toggle or relabel a firewall rule
put.description: Switch a single rule on or off without deleting it, or change its comment. Returns 409 `firewall_paused` while the firewall is switched off.

get.description: Managed Email plans with mailbox, alias, storage and send limits. `storageGb` is per mailbox; `sendLimitPerDay` applies to the whole domain (all mailboxes share it); there is no hourly limit.

Every active or suspended Managed Email subscription of the token owner, each with its domain, mailboxes (incl. live storage usage and the aliases that deliver to them) and aliases. Also returns the mail client settings (IMAP/SMTP/POP3 host and ports).

post.description:
Order a Managed Email subscription (charged from balance: the first month now, then monthly). One free plan per account. An optional `domain` is attached right away (it still has to be verified). Optional `voucherId` applies a discount voucher to the first month.

Errors: `400 invalid_plan`, `400 invalid_domain`, `402 insufficient_balance`, `409 free_limit`, `409 domain_taken`, `409 profile_incomplete` (billing address missing).

get.description:
One subscription with its domain, mailboxes and aliases - the same bundle the list returns.

Errors: `404 subscription_not_found`.

post.description:
Attach your domain to the subscription (one domain per subscription). Returns the DNS records to publish; the `_instantnode-verify` TXT record proves ownership.

Errors: `400 invalid_domain`, `404 subscription_not_found`, `409 subscription_inactive`, `409 domain_limit`, `409 domain_taken`.

get.description:
The DNS records the domain needs (MX, SPF, ownership TXT, DKIM, DMARC), what is already visible in public DNS (`live`), and whether InstantNode hosts the zone and can write the records for you (`dnsZone.managed`).

Errors: `404 domain_not_found`.

post.description:
For domains registered with InstantNode on our nameservers: write the mail records into the zone (replacing existing MX/SPF/DMARC/DKIM in those slots, leaving everything else alone), then verify the domain in the same call.

Errors: `404 domain_not_found`, `409 subscription_inactive`, `409 dns_not_managed` (`reason`: `not_registered_here` | `external_nameservers` | `domain_not_active`).

Check the ownership TXT record and, once it is visible, activate the domain on the mail server (DKIM is generated then). Mailboxes and aliases can be created after this succeeds.

Errors: `404 domain_not_found`, `422 verify_failed` (with `live` showing which records are still missing).

delete.description:
Remove the domain from the subscription so a different one can be added. **Deletes every mailbox (with all stored mail) and every alias of the domain.** Cannot be undone.

Errors: `404 subscription_not_found`, `404 domain_not_found`.

post.description:
Create a mailbox on the verified domain. `password` 8-128 characters; `quotaMb` is optional and capped at the plan's per-mailbox storage (default: the full plan storage).

Errors: `400 invalid_localpart`, `400 invalid_password`, `404 subscription_not_found`, `409 subscription_inactive`, `409 no_domain`, `409 domain_unverified`, `409 localpart_taken`, `409 mailbox_limit`.

patch.description:
Change the mailbox password and/or its quota (`quotaMb`, up to the plan's per-mailbox storage). A password change also restores a mailbox that went missing on the mail server.

Errors: `400 invalid_password`, `404 mailbox_not_found`, `409 storage_exceeded`, `409 mailbox_missing_on_server`.

delete.description:
Delete the mailbox and all mail stored in it. It is removed from every alias that delivered to it; aliases left without any mailbox are deleted too (listed in `aliases.deleted`).

Errors: `404 mailbox_not_found`.

get.description:
The subscription's aliases with their target mailboxes, the plan's alias limit and the maximum number of targets per alias.

Errors: `404 subscription_not_found`.

post.description:
Create a forwarding address (`localPart`@your domain) that delivers to 1-10 of the subscription's own mailboxes (`mailboxIds`). The address must not be used by a mailbox or another alias. The number of aliases is capped by the plan (`aliasLimit`). Up to 30 alias changes per 5 minutes.

Errors: `400 invalid_localpart`, `400 no_targets`, `400 too_many_targets`, `400 target_not_found`, `404 subscription_not_found`, `409 subscription_inactive`, `409 no_domain`, `409 domain_unverified`, `409 address_taken`, `409 alias_limit`, `429 rate_limited`.

patch.description:
Replace the alias's target mailboxes (`mailboxIds`, 1-10) and/or pause it (`active: false` - mail to it is rejected) or resume it. Only while the subscription is active.

Errors: `400 nothing_to_update`, `400 invalid_active`, `400 no_targets`, `400 too_many_targets`, `400 target_not_found`, `404 alias_not_found`, `409 subscription_inactive`, `429 rate_limited`.

delete.description:
Delete the alias. The mailboxes it delivered to and their mail are not touched.

Errors: `404 alias_not_found`, `429 rate_limited`.

get.description:
What moving to a larger plan (`?plan=`) costs right now. Paid plans pay only the monthly difference for the rest of the billing period; free to paid charges one full month and starts the billing cycle.

Errors: `400 invalid_plan`, `404 subscription_not_found`, `409 downgrade_not_allowed`, `409 proration_unavailable`.

post.description:
Move the subscription to a larger plan (charged from balance, same price as the quote). Plans only move up. Mailbox storage, protocols and send limits are raised right away.

Errors: `400 invalid_plan`, `402 insufficient_balance`, `404 subscription_not_found`, `409 downgrade_not_allowed`, `409 proration_unavailable`, `409 over_new_mailbox_limit`, `409 profile_incomplete`.

get.description: Read-only billing: current balance, invoices (last 200) and transactions (last 500). Top-ups and payments cannot be initiated via the API.
Your profile and billing address.

patch.description: Update your billing address and avatar only. Username, e-mail and password can NOT be changed via the API.

get.description: Which notification e-mails are enabled.

patch.description: Toggle notification e-mails. Security, deletion and cancellation e-mails are always sent.

post.summary: Switch the whole firewall on or off
post.description: `enabled:false` disables every rule and remembers which ones were on; `enabled:true` restores exactly those. Anti-spoofing protection stays active either way.

Apply a built-in preset (key from `GET /v1/containers/firewall-presets`) or one of your saved presets as `custom:<presetId>`. `mode: replace` clears existing rules first. Returns 409 `firewall_paused` while the firewall is switched off.

post.summary: Save current rules as a preset
post.description: Snapshot this server's rules into a new saved preset on your account (max 20 presets).

get.description: Built-in presets and the presets saved on your account.

post.description: Rules use the same validation as adding a single rule.

bearerAuth.description: Personal Access Token. Create one in the panel under Profile -> API.

mailcowActive.description: Live on the mail server (mailboxes and aliases can be created).

aliases.description: Addresses of the aliases that deliver here (list/detail responses).
